actives.name: Loaded Dice
actives.text: The ally's next attack: crit chance +25%.

actives.name: Mulligan
actives.text: The ally may reroll their next miss.

actives.name: Fortune's Cure
actives.text: Heal 2d6 × 5% of max HP; Double Down.

actives.name: All In
actives.text: 2d6: 10 or more, triple damage to the burst; 4 or under, it hits you.

actives.name: Marked Card
actives.text: Marked; the next 2d6 rolled against it count as 11.

actives.name: House Rules
actives.text: Every ally's next Cast Lots roll is 7 or more.

actives.name: Cheat Death
actives.text: For 300 ticks the ally's injury rolls get a lucky reroll.

actives.name: Last Chip
actives.text: Damage grows as your HP falls; a crit if Cast Lots was 12 this turn.

passives.name: Lucky Streak
passives.text: Each 7+ Cast Lots roll in a row adds +2% crit (resets on 6 or less).

passives.name: Risk Taker
passives.text: Double Down fizzles one point later.

passives.name: Fortune Favors
passives.text: Event outcomes lean 10% toward the best one for this Scion.
